responsibility: Builds and normalizes the preprocessor’s effective include search chains by combining user options, environment variables, target hooks, sysroot and multilib adjustments, and the configured defaults from cppdefault.cc. It owns the quote/bracket/system/after chain data structures, path addition and sysroot rewriting, duplicate-directory elimination using filesystem identity or canonical names, verbose search-list reporting, and final registration of the merged chains with cpplib through cpp_set_include_chains.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file of the incpath pair: it builds, rewrites, deduplicates, merges, and registers the live include-directory chains using environment variables, sysroot handling, target hooks, and cppdefault data. Unlike gcc/incpath.h, it contains the path-construction algorithms and chain state rather than just the API and hook declarations.
